sentences.en: It's another Ghostbusters reference.
sentences.zh: 这又是一个《捉鬼敢死队》的梗。

sentences.en: So, we love to read a letter that we've received from How I Met Your Mother fans and lovers of the show,
sentences.zh: 那么，我们很乐意读一封来自《老爸老妈浪漫史》粉丝、本剧爱好者以及播客之友的来信，

sentences.en: friends of the pod, and Craig is going to read this week's letter.
sentences.zh: 克雷格将宣读本周的信件。

sentences.en: Take it away, Craig.
sentences.zh: 开始吧，克雷格。

sentences.en: Yes, we read these as cold as possible.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们尽量不带任何预设情感来朗读这些内容。

sentences.en: We haven't usually pre-read them, but I see the name Wesleyan University in it,
sentences.zh: 我们通常不会提前阅读，但我看到里面提到了卫斯理大学这个名字，

sentences.en: which is where I went to college with Alec Lev, and I met Carter Bayes, and I met my wife,
sentences.zh: 那是我和亚历克·莱夫一起上大学的地方，我在那儿遇到了卡特·贝斯，还遇到了我的妻子，

sentences.en: so I thought Wesleyan's in there, so I'll read this one.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想既然提到了卫斯理，那我就读这封吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Dear Hwimim Gang, I am Lizette, an almost 30-year-old writer from the humble utopia of Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的惠米姆·甘格，我是莉泽特，一个快三十岁的作家，来自康涅狄格州这个简朴的乌托邦。

sentences.en: How I Met Your Mother has been a dynamic character in the story of my young adulthood,
sentences.zh: 《老爸老妈浪漫史》一直是我年轻时的成长故事中充满活力的一部分，

sentences.en: starting in my senior year of high school.
sentences.zh: 从我高中的最后一年开始。

sentences.en: It was my older sister who attended Wesleyan University during the show's final years
sentences.zh: 正是我的大姐，在剧集播出的最后几年就读于卫斯理大学，

sentences.en: who inspired me to start watching the show.
sentences.zh: 她启发了我开始看这部剧。

sentences.en: Minutes into the pilot, I realized it was no longer about wanting to like the same things as my cool big sister.
sentences.zh: 试播集播出几分钟后，我意识到这不再是因为我想和酷酷的大姐喜欢同样的东西。

sentences.en: This was something that spoke to my soul in a way no sitcom had before.
sentences.zh: 这是某种能触及我心灵深处的东西，是以前没有任何情景喜剧能做到的。

sentences.en: I instantly felt seen by Ted's unapologetic yearning for the certainty of the one,
sentences.zh: 我瞬间觉得泰德那种对命中注定的坚定信念的毫不掩饰的渴望被理解了，

sentences.en: and hoped I'd get lucky like Marshall and Lily once I got to college.
sentences.zh: 并希望自己上大学后能像马歇尔和莉莉那样幸运。

sentences.en: As a high schooler, I thought I was too sad and too weird to have that typical group of friends,
sentences.zh: 作为一个高中生，我以为自己太伤感、太古怪，不配拥有那种典型的小圈子朋友，

sentences.en: let alone a romantic partner.
sentences.zh: 更不用说浪漫伴侣了。

sentences.en: As a result, I isolated myself and didn't partake in high school-y things like incestuous friend groups
sentences.zh: 因此，我将自己封闭起来，不参加那些高中式的活动，比如错综复杂的朋友圈

sentences.en: and best proms ever.
sentences.zh: 和号称最棒的毕业舞会。

sentences.en: Field hockey finals were in the fall, so I couldn't use that as an excuse like Robin.
sentences.zh: 曲棍球决赛在秋季举行，所以我不能像罗宾那样把它当作借口。

sentences.en: It felt fitting that I watched the finale by myself, sitting on the edge of my parents' bed,
sentences.zh: 独自一人坐在父母的床边，看着泪水顺脸颊流淌，看大结局时我觉得这一切正合适。

sentences.en: with tears streaming down my face.
sentences.zh: 泪水顺着我的脸庞流淌。

sentences.en: Not because I was disappointed by the ending, but because I hadn't realized how much I needed a sitcom
sentences.zh: 不是因为我对结局感到失望，而是因为我之前没意识到自己多么需要一部情景喜剧

sentences.en: to punch me in the gut like that.
sentences.zh: 能这样狠狠地给我当头一棒。

sentences.en: Finally, I wasn't too sad and too weird for something mainstream.
sentences.zh: 终于，对于主流大众的文化，我不再觉得过于悲伤或古怪了。

sentences.en: With college on the horizon, I was able to imagine a happier tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 随着大学的临近，我开始能够想象一个更快乐的明天。

sentences.en: Maybe I'd get into Wesleyan, following the footsteps of Ted, Marshall, Lily, Craig, Carter, and my big sister.
sentences.zh: 也许我能考上卫斯理大学，追随泰德、马歇尔、莉莉、克雷格、卡特和大姐的脚步。

sentences.en: On Siblings Weekend, I enjoyed my first sandwich outside my sister's freshman dorm, Butterfield.
sentences.zh: 在兄弟姐妹周末，我在我大姐的大一宿舍巴特菲尔德外面享受了我的第一个三明治。

sentences.en: The Butts, she called it.
sentences.zh: 她管那叫“屁股楼”。

sentences.en: That's a fact.
sentences.zh: 千真万确。

sentences.en: It is called that.
sentences.zh: 它确实叫这个名字。

sentences.en: I could probably do that for the next four years, and my mental illness would eventually dissipate, right?
sentences.zh: 我大概可以在接下来的四年里一直这样做，我的精神疾病最终会烟消云散，对吧？

sentences.en: Wrong.
sentences.zh: 错。

sentences.en: I was rejected by Wesleyan, first of all.
sentences.zh: 首先，我被卫斯理大学拒绝了。

sentences.en: Don't feel too bad for me, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，也别太为我难过。

sentences.en: I'd end up among my people, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 我最终还是找到了同类，也就是

sentences.en: other Wesleyan rejects, at Skidmore College,
sentences.zh: 其他被卫斯理拒绝的人，在斯基德莫尔学院，

sentences.en: where I'd play softball and double major in English and psych.
sentences.zh: 在那里我打垒球，并主修英语和心理学双学位。

sentences.en: Salute, major in English and psych.
sentences.zh: 向英语和心理学专业致敬。

sentences.en: And I'd visit my sister at Wesleyan occasionally.
sentences.zh: 我偶尔还会去卫斯理大学看望姐姐。

sentences.en: We'd even attend Craig and Carter's hymium panel in the chapel and awkwardly wave to them outside the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至会去礼拜堂参加克雷格和卡特的 hymium 座谈会，并在洗手间外面尴尬地向他们挥手。

sentences.en: I remember you.
sentences.zh: 我记得你。

sentences.en: My first few months away at college were a hard transition.
sentences.zh: 刚离家去上大学的前几个月是一段艰难的过渡期。

sentences.en: I was making friends, but I craved the security of family.
sentences.zh: 我交到了朋友，但我渴望家庭带来的安全感。

sentences.en: I felt like I was floundering at sea.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己就像在海里苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Fish are weird, right?
sentences.zh: 鱼都很奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: But eventually, I discovered that if I turned on the common room TV between classes,
sentences.zh: 但最终，我发现如果在课间打开休息室的电视，

sentences.en: I might see the gang pop up on the screen, making jokes I was already in on,
sentences.zh: 我可能会看到那帮老友出现在屏幕上，开着我早就心领神会的玩笑，

sentences.en: navigating problems I knew they'd get through.
sentences.zh: 解决着我知道他们总能挺过去的麻烦。

sentences.en: It was like getting thrown a lifeboat each time the show was on.
sentences.zh: 每当这部剧播出时，就好像有人向我抛来了一艘救生艇。

sentences.en: So, thank you, Craig and Josh, for the boats, boats, boats.
sentences.zh: 所以，谢谢克雷格和乔希，谢谢你们的“船，船，船”。

sentences.en: Two English degrees, several heartbreaks, and a bad challenge-accepted tattoo later.
sentences.zh: 历经两个英语学位、几次失恋，还有一个冲动之下的“挑战接受”纹身之后。

sentences.en: Sure, I am about to be 30 in this stage of life.
sentences.zh: 当然，在这个人生阶段，我快要30岁了。

sentences.en: I relate to the gang on a whole new level, like how success often comes at the expense of our values
sentences.zh: 我对剧中的伙伴们有了全新的共鸣，比如成功往往以牺牲我们的价值观为代价

sentences.en: or how love is the best thing we do, but it's not always enough.
sentences.zh: 或者爱是我们做过最好的事，但它并不总是足够。

sentences.en: Luckily, I'm less worried about finding the one these days.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，这些天我没那么担心寻找真爱了。

sentences.en: My boyfriend and I just celebrated our three-year anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我和男友刚刚庆祝了三周年纪念日。

sentences.en: His name is Matt, the M to my L.
sentences.zh: 他叫马特，我是L，他是M。

sentences.en: I still fall asleep to him-yum every night, just not alone.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚上依然听着他的声音入睡——真香，只是不再孤单。

sentences.en: So, thank you for creating my comfort show, my guidebook, my family,
sentences.zh: 所以，感谢你们创造了我的解压神剧、我的生活指南、我的家人，

sentences.en: and thank you for turning it into my new comfort podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你们把它变成了我新的精神慰藉播客。

sentences.en: It sometimes feels like I'm auditing the creative writing class of my dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉就像是在旁听我梦寐以求的创意写作课。

sentences.en: It even makes me want to try screenwriting, which is scary, but as Ted would say,
sentences.zh: 这甚至让我想要尝试编剧，这很吓人，但正如泰德所说，

sentences.en: if you're not scared, you're not taking a chance.
sentences.zh: 如果你不害怕，说明你根本没在冒险。

sentences.en: If you're not taking a chance, then what the hell are you doing?
sentences.zh: 如果你连险都不冒，那到底在干什么鬼？

sentences.en: Would you say I should make adjustments?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我该做点调整吗？

sentences.en: Go get it energized, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 去振作起来吧，玛吉。

sentences.en: If so, then challenge accepted.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，那我就接受挑战。

sentences.en: Love, your favorite Wesleyan reject, Lizette.
sentences.zh: 爱你的、你最喜欢的卫斯理大学弃儿莉杰特。

sentences.en: That's a hell of a letter, Lizette.
sentences.zh: 这信写得太绝了，莉杰特。

sentences.en: My God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Maybe Wesleyan's going to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 也许卫斯理大学会重新考虑的。

sentences.en: Maybe they'll give her the second Distinguished Non-Alumni Alumni Award like I got.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会颁给她第二个杰出“非校友”校友奖，就像我拿的那样。

sentences.en: You're getting cocky with that thing.
sentences.zh: 你拿着那玩意儿开始飘了啊。

sentences.en: You're getting cocky.
sentences.zh: 你真的是飘了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have changed since I got that award.
sentences.zh: 没错，自从拿到那个奖之后，我变了。

sentences.en: You have.
sentences.zh: 你是变了。

sentences.en: You've been strutting around for like the last year and a half.
sentences.zh: 过去一年半左右你一直趾高气扬的。

sentences.en: Josh, we did an event at Wesleyan, which will become a podcast episode one of these days, right, Alex?
sentences.zh: 乔希，我们在卫斯理大学办了一场活动，过几天这就会变成一期播客节目，对吧，亚历克斯？

sentences.en: So, keeping your eye out for that.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家敬请期待吧。

sentences.en: And at the event, Wesleyan honored Josh by giving, because we, Carter and I, Carter and I got these Distinguished Alumni Awards.
sentences.zh: 在活动上，卫斯理大学向乔希颁发了奖项，因为我们，我和卡特，我和卡特拿到了这些杰出校友奖。

sentences.en: And we're like so moved.
sentences.zh: 当时我们超级感动。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, we got these things.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们竟然拿到了这东西。

sentences.en: And we're like, we're also giving one to Josh, the first non-alum Distinguished Alumni Award.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就想，我们也要给乔希颁发一个，首个非校友的杰出校友奖。

sentences.en: And it was hilarious.
sentences.zh: 当时可太搞笑了。

sentences.en: Well, I think I said something along the lines of, I've always felt that Wesleyan should give me something because I'm one of the more famous fictional grads of Wesleyan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我当时大概说过这样的话：我一直觉得卫斯理大学就该给我颁个奖，因为我是卫斯理大学最著名的虚构毕业生之一。

sentences.en: You are, I mean.
sentences.zh: 你确实是，我是说。

sentences.en: And I believe, was it Alec who said, hold on.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信，是亚历克说的吗，等等。

sentences.en: Yes, you made the joke at the event.
sentences.zh: 没错，你在活动上开了这个玩笑。

sentences.en: We're in front of a big crowd at Wesleyan and you said it and Alec was like, funny, you should say that.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在卫斯理大学面对着一大群观众，你刚说完，亚历克就接了一句：说得好啊。

sentences.en: And then it really is.
sentences.zh: 然后还真的是这样。

sentences.en: My jaw hit the floor.
sentences.zh: 我的下巴都惊掉了。

sentences.en: It was great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It was a magical setup for that moment.
sentences.zh: 那是为那一刻做出的神仙般的铺垫。

sentences.en: I was the recipient of the first ever Distinguished Alumni, Non-Alumni Alumni Award, something like that.
sentences.zh: 我是史上第一个“杰出校友、非校友校友奖”得主，诸如此类的奖项。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: It was well-worded.
sentences.zh: 措辞很精妙。

sentences.en: We got to look it up.
sentences.zh: 我们得去查查。

sentences.en: We all got certificates, so you have it there somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们都拿到了证书，所以你手里某处肯定有。

sentences.en: We'll read it.
sentences.zh: 我们会读出来的。

sentences.en: We'll read it out loud when we do that episode.
sentences.zh: 等我们录那一集时，我们会把它大声读出来。

sentences.en: But Lizette, that was a fantastic letter.
sentences.zh: 但是莉泽特，那封信真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Lizette, that was absolutely fantastic, well-written, vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 莉泽特，那封信真的太棒了，文笔优美，真情流露。

sentences.en: Just, yeah, I'm really honored by that letter, Lizette.
sentences.zh: 总之，是的，莉泽特，我真的为那封信感到荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I know Carter would be too.
sentences.zh: 我知道卡特也会这么觉得。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, you didn't go to Wesleyan, go to Wesleyan, but the idea that the show meant this to you and you found your path.
sentences.zh: 对不起，你没有去卫斯理大学，没有去卫斯理大学，但这个节目对你意味着这么多，让你找到了自己的人生方向。

sentences.en: And you had your first sandwich at Wesleyan.
sentences.zh: 而且你在卫斯理大学吃了你的第一个三明治。

sentences.en: Your first sandwich was had there.
sentences.zh: 你的第一个三明治是在那里吃的。

sentences.en: It was very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这非常有意义。

sentences.en: And you found the M to your L.
sentences.zh: 而且你找到了你的 M 和 L。

sentences.en: And it's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Please stay with us on the podcast because you're why we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 请继续关注我们的播客，因为这就是我们做这个节目的原因。

sentences.en: So we really appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的很感激你。

sentences.en: And if you want to send in a letter of your own or a voice note that we might play at the beginning of the show, please go to HowWeMadeYourMother.com, H-W-M-Y-M.com.
sentences.zh: 如果你想发送你自己的信件或语音便签，我们可能会在节目开头播放，请访问 HowWeMadeYourMother.com，即 H-W-M-Y-M.com。

sentences.en: Go to contact and follow the instructions.
sentences.zh: 进入联系页面并按照说明操作。

sentences.en: Pretty easy to send us a note.
sentences.zh: 给我们发便签挺容易的。

sentences.en: And then we also just point out that Lizette originally connected to us through the Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还要指出，莉泽特最初是通过 Facebook 群组与我们联系的。

sentences.en: So please go check us on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 所以请去 Facebook 上关注我们。

sentences.en: It's actually the Major Fans Facebook group rather than having our own Facebook page now.
sentences.zh: 其实现在是“Major Fans”Facebook 群组，而不是我们自己的 Facebook 主页。

sentences.en: We are collaborating.
sentences.zh: 我们在合作。

sentences.en: We are working with Becky who does the great fan Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与运营这个优秀粉丝 Facebook 群组的贝基合作。

sentences.en: And Lizette basically said, hey, I sent you a letter.
sentences.zh: 莉泽特基本上说，嘿，我给你们写了一封信。

sentences.en: And it was about this and that.
sentences.zh: 内容是关于这个和那个的。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, I'm sorry, I missed it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哦，对不起，我漏掉了。

sentences.en: Send it again.
sentences.zh: 再发一遍。

sentences.en: And she did.
sentences.zh: 她照做了。

sentences.en: And here it is.
sentences.zh: 信就在这里。

sentences.en: So join that Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 所以快加入那个 Facebook 群组吧。

sentences.en: We do actually read what y'all are saying.
sentences.zh: 我们确实会看你们大家说的话。

sentences.en: I'm there online and directing with all of you.
sentences.zh: 我一直在网上和你们所有人互动。

sentences.en: And so check out the Major Fans group.
sentences.zh: 所以去看看 Major Fans 群组吧。

sentences.en: And there will be a link to that on our website, too.
sentences.zh: 我们的网站上也会有指向该群组的链接。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's the best part of doing this is hearing from you guys.
sentences.zh: 做这件事最棒的部分就是听到你们的声音。

sentences.en: So please keep them coming.
sentences.zh: 所以请继续给我们发信。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们加入我们。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。

sentences.en: Our theme song is New York City by our own Josh Radner,
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是《纽约市》，由我们自己的乔什·拉德纳创作，

sentences.en: with additional music by Craig Thomas and Andrew Majewski.
sentences.zh: 附加音乐由克雷格·托马斯和安德鲁·马杰夫斯基提供。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Theobald and Elliot Connors.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢山姆·西奥博尔德和埃利奥特·康纳斯。

sentences.en: Go to howwemadeyourmother.com to learn more and click on the contact page
sentences.zh: 访问 howwemadeyourmother.com 了解更多信息，并点击联系页面

sentences.en: to send us an email or a voice message.
sentences.zh: 向我们发送电子邮件或语音留言。

sentences.en: Your stories and questions are an important part of the show.
sentences.zh: 你们的故事和问题是本节目的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Subscribe to Josh Radner's museletters on Substack
sentences.zh: 在 Substack 上订阅乔什·拉德纳的灵感通信

sentences.en: and check out his music and everything else at joshradner.com.
sentences.zh: 并访问 joshradner.com 了解他的音乐以及其他一切。

sentences.en: Order Craig Thomas' debut novel, That's Not How It Happened,
sentences.zh: 订购克雷格·托马斯的处女作小说《事情不是那样的》，

sentences.en: wherever books are sold,
sentences.zh: 各大书店均有销售，

sentences.en: and read his other published writing at craigtomaswriter.com.
sentences.zh: 并在 craigtomaswriter.com 阅读他的其他发表作品。

sentences.en: And you can subscribe to my own Dead Fathers Society on Substack.
sentences.zh: 你还可以在 Substack 上订阅我自己的“已故父亲协会”。

sentences.en: To learn about how you make a difference,
sentences.zh: 要了解如何发挥作用，

sentences.en: this show's ongoing campaign to raise funds for congenital heart disease research,
sentences.zh: 本节目为先天性心脏病研究筹集资金的长期活动，

sentences.en: check out the Make a Difference tab at the top of our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看我们网站顶部的“发挥作用”标签页。

sentences.en: People will, in fact, dance.
sentences.zh: 事实上，人们会跳舞。

sentences.en: Real question.
sentences.zh: 真心请教个问题。

sentences.en: It just hit me.
sentences.zh: 我突然想到的。

sentences.en: Am I in love with you?
sentences.zh: 我是爱上你了吗？

sentences.en: Or just New York City?
sentences.zh: 还是只是爱上了纽约市？
